title: Sims Metal Management Ltd - proposed acquisition of Commercial Metal Recycling Services Pty Ltd
targets: Commercial Metal Recycling Services Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Sims Metal Management Ltd proposed to acquire Commercial Metal Recycling Services Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed merger within the context of: - regional markets for the acquisition of ferrous scrap from scrap originators, scrap collectors and scrap dealers in Queensland; - regional markets for the acquisition of non-ferrous scrap from scrap originators, scrap collectors and scrap dealers in Queensland; -the markets for the supply of ferrous scrap metal to end users such as metal manufacturers, smelters and foundries in Queensland; and -the market for the supply of non-ferrous scrap metal to end users such as metal manufacturers, smelters and foundries Australia. For the purposes of the competition analysis, the ACCC did not consider it necessary to form a definitive view regarding market definition.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed merger was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. Key factors informing this conclusion included: - In relation to both ferrous and non-ferrous scrap, there would remain a number of scrap dealers post acquisition that would compete to acquire scrap; and - In relation to both ferrous and non-ferrous scrap, there would remain a number of scrap dealers post acquisition that would compete to supply scrap.
